emailsToDoctor.html:
GP Link

Time to prepare your practice pack,

Now that your placement at Metro Practice (FAKE) is secured, there are a few documents that need to be completed before you can start.

Your practice pack includes:

  • SPPA-00 Agreement

View Documents

If you have questions about any document, message us on WhatsApp at +61 494 391 968.

Kind regards,
GP Link Recruitment Team
